method: For each host: robots.txt for the submission path, then the site root, from which the terms URL is DERIVED out of the anchors (never guessed), then the document is required to look like a legal text before any verdict, then prohibited-activity clauses are matched with their governing sentence searched up to 2500 chars back.
population: The 86 destinations of type 'directory' and pricing 'free' in the public Submitlist catalog (data/destinations.json of alvinunreal/awesome-submitlist, CC0, synced 2026-09-21), deduplicated to 84 hosts.
honest_caveat: The 45 undetermined are a limit of this probe, not a property of those sites. All 18 terms clauses were read by hand before publication.
